shortcut_xmlgui_merge: KDE migrates the embedded native Dolphin UI and retains Preview ActionProperties; complete existing UI documents are preserved
hidden_device_defaults: Only positively identified read-only Atomic root and fixed system-only /boot or /boot/efi entries; native XBEL IsHidden, UUID-first matching, explicit visibility choices preserved
preserved_device_access: Removable, hot-pluggable, unknown and data-bearing volumes remain visible; no mounts, labels, udev policies or capacity-warning behavior changed
places_ownership_records: ~/.local/state/aven/places/<UTC-timestamp>-<unique-suffix>.json; cumulative schema_version 1 component aven-places; exact changed-entry identifiers, previous flag state, before/after XBEL hashes; no record for unchanged or previously hidden items
video_initial_state: Paused at position zero with first decoded frame; no play() call until explicit action
native_navigation: Dolphin remains responsible for folders, selection, sorting and file operations
visual_verification: pending Fedora desktop boot and paired screenshot critic
limitations: Preview is local-file only; remote KIO locations retain the stock information panel and native applications.
Text supports Unicode encodings; unmarked legacy encodings open in the full application.
Media codecs are those provided by Fedora Qt Multimedia. H.264/HEVC availability must be tested on the image.
Images are fit to window; detailed image browsing/editing remains in Gwenview.
Space remains Dolphin selection mode. It is not globally rebound, preserving Chinese IME shortcuts.
